# SoraKbd

Displays a key or a keyboard shortcut.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | display |
| Import | `import { SoraKbd } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraKbd from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraKbd'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/display/SoraKbd.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/display/SoraKbd.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keys` | `readonly string[]` |  | Keys of a shortcut, rendered as nested `<kbd>` elements joined by `separator`. |
| `separator` | `string` | `'+'` | Text between keys. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` | `'md'` | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | A single key. Ignored when `keys` is set. |

## Attributes

The `<kbd>` element.

## Accessibility

- Uses `<kbd>`; a shortcut nests one `<kbd>` per key, as HTML recommends.

## Styling

- `.sora-kbd`, `.sora-kbd-combo`
- `data-size`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<p class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sora-sm">
  <span>{{ t('demo.kbd.palette') }}</span>
  <SoraKbd :keys="['Ctrl', 'K']" />
  <SoraKbd>Esc</SoraKbd>
  <SoraKbd size="sm">Tab</SoraKbd>
  <SoraKbd size="lg" :keys="['Shift', 'Alt', 'F']" />
</p>
```
